content.value: A y-polarized uniform plane wave $( \vec { E } _ { i } , \vec { H } _ { i } )$ with a frequency 100 MHz propagates in air in the +x direction and impinges normally on a perfectly conducting plane at $\scriptstyle \mathbf { x } = 0$ Assuming the amplitude of $\vec { E } _ { i }$ to be 6 mV/m, write the phasor and instantaneous expressions for $\mathbf { \rho } ( \mathrm { i } ) \cdot \Vec { E } _ { i }$ and $\vec { H } _ { i }$ of the incident wave; (ii) $\smash { \vec { E } _ { r } }$ and $\vec { H } ,$ of the reflected wave.
